design_checks.primary_comparison: R2 uses three final members in both arms with the same architecture/topology, seeds, shared 15-node per-fold ancestor graph, parents, fit memberships, normalization, optimizer/scheduler, epochs/update budgets, fixed checkpoints, provider/runtime requirement, and fixed 0.34/0.33/0.33 blend. The only allowed config differences are the four declared final distillation/family-loss weights.
design_checks.control_interpretation: Control zeros only final-member teacher/family supervision. It is not described as a KD-free pipeline: the shared fbc1k_s5 parent remains distilled from clean fin256 teachers. The rank-1 endpoint is descriptive historical context only.
design_checks.zero_weight_topology: The control retains the candidate family-head architecture and parameter/checkpoint topology. Exact labels-only alpha-zero behavior and zero family-head gradient remain explicit capability/review requirements; the packet does not claim they are implemented.
design_checks.shared_ancestry: The estimand is conditional on one shared fixed-role graph per fold and does not estimate teacher-refit variability or isolate upstream distillation.

remaining_preregistration_and_capability: Recovering the historical creative prop_f0 and W18 producer details is not required for attribution if all new clean per-fold propensity fits and cache targets are rebuilt and bound to their actual source/code, data/split, membership/rows, normalization/preprocessing, checkpoints and runtime.

Implement and independently review strict-FP32 propensity and tiedlead/family-head capability, including exact zero-alpha loss behavior, same topology, causal feature semantics, finite/row-bound caches and export shape.

Pin/recompute the exact F2 manifest and counts; refresh all four fold manifests, ordered memberships, source/data/runtime identities and the prospective practical effect rule before preregistration and before outcomes.
Complete a separate dated preregistration and root admission/resource review before any experiment execution; this design review itself grants no admission or execution authority.
scope_limits: Static document and JSON metadata review only; no source execution, tests, model/checkpoint/prediction/parquet payload reads, fitting, inference, cache generation, remote operations, or admission.

The review evaluates design structure and declared source pins, not the correctness of unimplemented model adapters, numerical behavior, producer capability, runtime feasibility, or scientific outcomes.
